title: Engram control calls exceed the host's 20 s deadline under build load and park TermAl sessions in an unknown state
outcome: Engram control calls exceed the host's 20 s deadline under build load and park TermAl sessions in an unknown state
acceptance: A control call that cannot finish within a bound below the host deadline returns a definite typed retryable refusal with remote not started (or a settled result) instead of leaving the outcome unknown, covered by a deterministic test that injects the slow phase

completion.summary: Delivered and landed the cooperative 15-second control-frame allowance, phase-safe typed expiry with successful rollback certification, settled late-COMMIT results and exact-key reconciliation. Full gate12/12, independent Codex/Claude pair and fresh post-landing acceptance1/1 passed; criterion count1 and acceptance revision2 unchanged. Clean release installed with backup; readiness6/6 before and after installation. Existing processes retain their prior build until a supported restart. External TermAl bounded-retry conformance remains unproved and independently tracked; Low coverage and unrelated load failure remain separate roots.
